Business_Rule_Register.rule: allow a person to exist on the agency roster without an ABox login. Roster-only profiles cannot sign in, receive system assignments, use referral identity or perform regulated actions, and can later be linked to an M00 user.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: use one tenant-scoped WorkforceProfile for every roster person with optional M00 user and M08 producer references. Administrator is a role assignment, not a separate person type.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: permit exactly one primary active agency affiliation in Lucie, preserve complete history and effective dates, and retain a future-safe seam for later concurrent affiliations.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: store CAPTIVE, INDEPENDENT or UNSPECIFIED with effective dates, source and history. M08 owns carrier-specific restrictions and selling enforcement.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: m06 owns the composite Agency and Agent Profile experience and operational fields. M08 owns credential records and M13 owns files; both are embedded without duplicate canonical stores.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: link an M06 operational profile to the M05 organization and require active organization and relationship, complete operational setup, valid administrator coverage, support contact and no blocking M06 exception.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: retain immutable M00 starter roles and permit versioned custom workforce roles from controlled permissions. Authorization evaluates permission and explicit scope rather than literal role name where possible.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: allow an active roster profile and affiliation before sellability. M08 must return an allowed contextual authority result before regulated actions.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: manual entry and all-or-nothing CSV import create draft profiles, run duplicate checks, establish affiliation and proposed roles, and never send invitations automatically.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: suspension revokes operational access immediately. Effective-dated offboarding ends affiliation, removes applicable access, triggers downstream reevaluation and reassigns open work while preserving history and attribution.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: a standard agent setup must be completable through one guided experience without requiring users to navigate module boundaries.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: use Overview, Access and Affiliation, Selling Setup, Marketplace, Tasks and Exceptions, and History as Agent Profile sections.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: use Overview, Locations and Contacts, Roster, Selling Setup, Marketplace, Tasks and Exceptions, and History as Agency Profile sections.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: maintain separate profile, affiliation, account access, credential readiness, marketplace readiness, availability and contextual selling-authority statuses. Generic Active never implies sellability.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: use a save-and-resume flow for Profile, Agency and Affiliation, Access, Selling Setup, Marketplace, Review and Activate, skipping inapplicable steps.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: permit profile, affiliation and selling-setup work before invitation. Authorized administrators or the agent may complete permitted portions after account activation.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: show Ready, Ready with limitations, Not ready or Review required only as a summary that opens reason-coded product, carrier, state and channel detail supplied by M08.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: allow role-permitted entry and update while showing whether credential data is API validated, manually verified, document supported or self reported.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: missing, rejected, expired or soon-to-expire items create contextual M00 tasks identifying the blocker, resolver, owner and next action.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: include M08 component slots, interfaces and fixtures but never manufacture a positive selling decision while M08 is unavailable.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: use an immutable tenant-scoped roster profile that may reference one global M00 user and one M08 producer identity without exposing another tenant's data.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: use DRAFT, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED and INACTIVE for profiles and PLANNED, ACTIVE, ENDED and CANCELED for affiliations; readiness remains separate.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: support immediate and future effective timestamps, prohibit overlapping primary affiliations, and use governed correction records once downstream activity exists.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: permit atomic same-hierarchy transfer by authorized root or JET users, downline release within scope, cross-tenant migration controls, and rehire through the existing profile.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: office and manager are optional operational assignments, must be valid and acyclic, may drive routing and reporting, and grant no authority by themselves.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Business_Rule_Register.rule: apply M05 root/downline scope, limit ordinary users to their own composite profile, and allow self update only for approved operational fields.
Business_Rule_Register.enforcement: Server-side command/query policy, canonical state validation and audit; UI controls are not authoritative.

Decision_Register.title: Roster-only people
Decision_Register.decision: Allow a person to exist on the agency roster without an ABox login. Roster-only profiles cannot sign in, receive system assignments, use referral identity or perform regulated actions, and can later be linked to an M00 user.

Decision_Register.title: Canonical workforce person model
Decision_Register.decision: Use one tenant-scoped WorkforceProfile for every roster person with optional M00 user and M08 producer references. Administrator is a role assignment, not a separate person type.

Decision_Register.title: One primary active affiliation
Decision_Register.decision: Permit exactly one primary active agency affiliation in Lucie, preserve complete history and effective dates, and retain a future-safe seam for later concurrent affiliations.

Decision_Register.title: Basic captivity classification
Decision_Register.decision: Store CAPTIVE, INDEPENDENT or UNSPECIFIED with effective dates, source and history. M08 owns carrier-specific restrictions and selling enforcement.

Decision_Register.title: Profile fields and embedded credential experience
Decision_Register.decision: M06 owns the composite Agency and Agent Profile experience and operational fields. M08 owns credential records and M13 owns files; both are embedded without duplicate canonical stores.

Decision_Register.title: Agency operational readiness
Decision_Register.decision: Link an M06 operational profile to the M05 organization and require active organization and relationship, complete operational setup, valid administrator coverage, support contact and no blocking M06 exception.

Decision_Register.title: Custom roles and scoped authorization
Decision_Register.decision: Retain immutable M00 starter roles and permit versioned custom workforce roles from controlled permissions. Authorization evaluates permission and explicit scope rather than literal role name where possible.

Decision_Register.title: Profile activation is not sellability
Decision_Register.decision: Allow an active roster profile and affiliation before sellability. M08 must return an allowed contextual authority result before regulated actions.

Decision_Register.title: Manual and CSV onboarding
Decision_Register.decision: Manual entry and all-or-nothing CSV import create draft profiles, run duplicate checks, establish affiliation and proposed roles, and never send invitations automatically.

Decision_Register.title: Suspension and offboarding
Decision_Register.decision: Suspension revokes operational access immediately. Effective-dated offboarding ends affiliation, removes applicable access, triggers downstream reevaluation and reassigns open work while preserving history and attribution.

Decision_Register.title: Single-workspace setup
Decision_Register.decision: A standard agent setup must be completable through one guided experience without requiring users to navigate module boundaries.

Decision_Register.title: Agent Profile sections
Decision_Register.decision: Use Overview, Access and Affiliation, Selling Setup, Marketplace, Tasks and Exceptions, and History as Agent Profile sections.

Decision_Register.title: Agency Profile sections
Decision_Register.decision: Use Overview, Locations and Contacts, Roster, Selling Setup, Marketplace, Tasks and Exceptions, and History as Agency Profile sections.

Decision_Register.title: Separate status dimensions
Decision_Register.decision: Maintain separate profile, affiliation, account access, credential readiness, marketplace readiness, availability and contextual selling-authority statuses. Generic Active never implies sellability.

Decision_Register.title: Guided onboarding sequence
Decision_Register.decision: Use a save-and-resume flow for Profile, Agency and Affiliation, Access, Selling Setup, Marketplace, Review and Activate, skipping inapplicable steps.

Decision_Register.title: Invitation timing
Decision_Register.decision: Permit profile, affiliation and selling-setup work before invitation. Authorized administrators or the agent may complete permitted portions after account activation.

Decision_Register.title: Contextual selling readiness
Decision_Register.decision: Show Ready, Ready with limitations, Not ready or Review required only as a summary that opens reason-coded product, carrier, state and channel detail supplied by M08.

Decision_Register.title: Credential provenance and permissions
Decision_Register.decision: Allow role-permitted entry and update while showing whether credential data is API validated, manually verified, document supported or self reported.

Decision_Register.title: Remediation tasks
Decision_Register.decision: Missing, rejected, expired or soon-to-expire items create contextual M00 tasks identifying the blocker, resolver, owner and next action.

Decision_Register.title: Behavior before M08
Decision_Register.decision: Include M08 component slots, interfaces and fixtures but never manufacture a positive selling decision while M08 is unavailable.

Decision_Register.title: Tenant-scoped workforce identity
Decision_Register.decision: Use an immutable tenant-scoped roster profile that may reference one global M00 user and one M08 producer identity without exposing another tenant's data.

Decision_Register.title: Profile and affiliation states
Decision_Register.decision: Use DRAFT, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED and INACTIVE for profiles and PLANNED, ACTIVE, ENDED and CANCELED for affiliations; readiness remains separate.

Decision_Register.title: Effective dates and corrections
Decision_Register.decision: Support immediate and future effective timestamps, prohibit overlapping primary affiliations, and use governed correction records once downstream activity exists.

Decision_Register.title: Transfer release and rehire
Decision_Register.decision: Permit atomic same-hierarchy transfer by authorized root or JET users, downline release within scope, cross-tenant migration controls, and rehire through the existing profile.

Decision_Register.title: Office and manager assignments
Decision_Register.decision: Office and manager are optional operational assignments, must be valid and acyclic, may drive routing and reporting, and grant no authority by themselves.

Decision_Register.title: Visibility and self service
Decision_Register.decision: Apply M05 root/downline scope, limit ordinary users to their own composite profile, and allow self update only for approved operational fields.

Decision_Register.title: Roster list search and filters
Decision_Register.decision: Provide fixed columns, search and filters for profile, affiliation, access, readiness, groups, tasks and marketplace status; exclude custom columns and saved views.

Decision_Register.title: Duplicate detection link and merge
Decision_Register.decision: Check verified email, linked user, roster reference and producer identity; never auto-merge fuzzy matches; preserve aliases, history, tasks and downstream references in governed merges.

Decision_Register.title: Roster import and export authority
Decision_Register.decision: Use M00 job orchestration with M06 templates, validations and scope. Imports are atomic; exports are purpose-bound, masked, audited and time limited.

Decision_Register.title: Safe bulk actions
Decision_Register.decision: Allow only office, manager, invitation, task and approved export actions after preflight. Exclude role, lifecycle, transfer, credential, referral and selling-authority bulk changes.

Decision_Register.title: Four note audiences
Decision_Register.decision: Support ME_ONLY, AGENCY_VISIBLE, JET_ONLY and CUSTOMER_VISIBLE with exact audience scope, confirmation, withdrawal, retention and audited break-glass behavior.

Decision_Register.title: Access ownership split
Decision_Register.decision: M00 owns permission catalogue, role engine, versioning, assignments and effective access. M06 owns business units, teams, memberships and agency-facing assignment workflows.

Decision_Register.title: Custom role constraints
Decision_Register.decision: Allow agencies to bundle only controlled agency-assignable permissions and prohibit custom permissions, JET authority, cross-tenant grants and system-policy overrides.

Decision_Register.title: Custom role lifecycle
Decision_Register.decision: Use DRAFT, ACTIVE and RETIRED; editing an active role creates a new draft version; roles cannot contain or inherit other roles.

Decision_Register.title: Business unit and team hierarchy
Decision_Register.decision: Support one optional business-unit level and one optional team level inside one M05 organization, with no nesting or cross-agency groups.

Decision_Register.title: Scoped role assignments
Decision_Register.decision: Assign roles directly or through group membership with explicit organization, business unit, team, self, assigned-record or owned-record scope.

Decision_Register.title: No implicit authority
Decision_Register.decision: Manager, team lead, job title, profile category and office assignments create no access without an explicit role assignment.

Decision_Register.title: Resource authorization context
Decision_Register.decision: Resources using group scope must carry or reliably derive organization, optional business unit, optional team and assigned user context; ambiguity fails closed.

Decision_Register.title: Access administration safeguards
Decision_Register.decision: Allow agency administrators to manage custom roles within scope while preventing JET authority and self-elevation; require recent authentication, reason and impact preview for sensitive changes.

Decision_Register.title: Immediate access invalidation
Decision_Register.decision: Role, permission, group and membership changes invalidate stale effective access immediately; active sessions and jobs reauthorize.

Decision_Register.title: Roles and Access front end
Decision_Register.decision: Provide System Roles, Custom Role Builder, Business Units and Teams, Role Assignments, Effective Access Inspector, Version History and Access Audit; exclude a free-form policy language.

Decision_Register.title: Progressive adoption
Decision_Register.decision: Preserve existing starter-role assignments and allow agencies to introduce custom roles progressively without redesigning all access at launch.

Decision_Register.title: Agency Administration Home
Decision_Register.decision: Provide one fixed agency-context home with roster, readiness, access, groups, tasks, exceptions, marketplace and credential summaries and explicit root/downline context.

Decision_Register.title: Agent Workspace
Decision_Register.decision: Provide one unified workspace for profile, affiliation, roles, groups, availability, credential and marketplace status, tasks and owner-managed downstream links.

Decision_Register.title: Readiness contract
Decision_Register.decision: Use READY, READY_WITH_LIMITATIONS, NOT_READY, REVIEW_REQUIRED and NOT_APPLICABLE with reason codes, owner, evaluation time, source version and next action.

Decision_Register.title: Agency operational-readiness contract
Decision_Register.decision: Publish authoritative M06 agency operational readiness based on M05 lifecycle, administrator coverage, support contact, defaults and blocking exceptions; marketplace activation remains M04-owned.

Decision_Register.title: Operational agent eligibility
Decision_Register.decision: Return OPERATIONALLY_ELIGIBLE, OPERATIONALLY_INELIGIBLE or REVIEW_REQUIRED based on profile, affiliation, scope, permission, availability and M06 blockers, never final regulatory authority.

Decision_Register.title: Embedded referral-link experience
Decision_Register.decision: Embed M04 referral-link components in profiles, roster and onboarding; M04 owns token and lifecycle, and raw tokens never enter M06 logs, exports or search.

Decision_Register.title: Operational availability
Decision_Register.decision: Support AVAILABLE, NOT_ACCEPTING_NEW_WORK and TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE with dates, reason and history; affect new work only and create review tasks for existing work.

Decision_Register.title: Affiliation operational attributes
Decision_Register.decision: Own affiliation status, dates, category, captivity, office, manager, business unit, teams, roles, languages, availability, onboarding and offboarding context, source and history.

Decision_Register.title: Operational service scope
Decision_Register.decision: Allow optional US-state and customer-service-language scope at agency, business unit, team and agent levels; lower levels may narrow but not expand agency scope and do not prove sellability.

Decision_Register.title: Defaults and explicit propagation
Decision_Register.decision: Copy fixed defaults at creation or explicitly apply later with impact preview; never silently propagate. Root role templates copy to local versioned roles without live inheritance.

Decision_Register.title: Tasks and exceptions
Decision_Register.decision: Use tasks for assigned work and exceptions for controlled blocking or review conditions. Closing tasks never closes an exception until system revalidation confirms resolution.

Decision_Register.title: Notification triggers
Decision_Register.decision: Notify only for action or awareness, including onboarding blockers, invitations, access changes, transfers, suspensions, offboarding, readiness changes and unresolved exceptions.

Decision_Register.title: SMS through Twilio
Decision_Register.decision: Support in-product, email and SMS through Twilio using verified mobile numbers, consent and preferences, minimal content, retries and delivery status.

Decision_Register.title: Notification ownership
Decision_Register.decision: M06 defines trigger, audience, urgency and action; shared notification services own templates and delivery; critical work remains an M00 task.

Decision_Register.title: Fixed escalation
Decision_Register.decision: Use fixed severity-based escalation to assignee then responsible team or administrator; agencies select responsible users or teams but cannot create unrestricted rules.

Decision_Register.title: Deduplication and digest
Decision_Register.decision: Deduplicate repeated events, link to the affected record, use immediate notices for blocking or access events and group routine reminders into a daily digest.

Decision_Register.title: Fixed operational reports
Decision_Register.decision: Provide fixed reports for roster, onboarding, invitations, roles, groups, lifecycle, tasks, exceptions, marketplace readiness and referral status.

Decision_Register.title: No custom report builder
Decision_Register.decision: Exclude a custom report builder in Lucie; provide useful fixed filters and sorting.

Decision_Register.title: CSV exports
Decision_Register.decision: Use on-demand CSV export through M00 job orchestration and exclude scheduled report delivery in Lucie.

Decision_Register.title: Report access controls
Decision_Register.decision: Apply effective role and organization scope, mask sensitive fields, require export purpose, audit every export and use time-limited reauthorized downloads.

Decision_Register.title: Credential report boundary
Decision_Register.decision: Include M08 readiness summaries, blocker counts and expiration indicators; detailed license and appointment reporting remains M08-owned.

Decision_Register.title: Versioned APIs
Decision_Register.decision: Provide versioned APIs for profiles, affiliations, groups, availability, lifecycle and operational controls; public third-party APIs are excluded.

Decision_Register.title: Composite read APIs
Decision_Register.decision: Provide composite Agency and Agent Profile reads that label owner and refresh time and do not create duplicate editable copies.

Decision_Register.title: Published events
Decision_Register.decision: Publish profile, affiliation, group, availability, readiness, lifecycle and offboarding events with sensitive-data minimization.

Decision_Register.title: Idempotency and concurrency
Decision_Register.decision: Use idempotency keys, entity versions, correlation IDs and consumer deduplication, and reject stale updates.

Decision_Register.title: Critical synchronous controls
Decision_Register.decision: Complete access revocation, tenant validation, affiliation validation and suspension controls before showing success; safe downstream updates may process asynchronously.

Decision_Register.title: Integration failure behavior
Decision_Register.decision: Allow safe draft work, fail closed for access, activation, marketplace eligibility and selling authority, retry automatically and create visible exceptions and tasks.

Decision_Register.title: Canonical reconciliation
Decision_Register.decision: Run scheduled and on-demand reconciliation; canonical owner wins, differences are logged and material conflicts create exceptions without silent overwrite.

Decision_Register.title: DOB and SSN handling
Decision_Register.decision: Store DOB in a protected global person identity record when required and full SSN only in an encrypted tokenized sensitive-data vault; M06 shows verification status or permitted masked values.

Decision_Register.title: Sensitive-field display
Decision_Register.decision: Mask sensitive values by default, require permission, scope, reason and audit to reveal, and exclude them from logs, events, notifications and standard exports.

Decision_Register.title: Recent authentication
Decision_Register.decision: Require recent authentication for privilege elevation, sensitive exports, cross-agency transfer, suspension, offboarding, break-glass and administrator-coverage changes.

Decision_Register.title: JET support access
Decision_Register.decision: Require explicit tenant and agency context, support-mode banner, purpose capture, time-limited access and complete audit; prohibit unrestricted browsing.

Decision_Register.title: Separate approval
Decision_Register.decision: Require independent approval for self-elevation and removal of the last active administrator; routine permitted assignments do not require dual approval.

Decision_Register.title: Immutable audit
Decision_Register.decision: Audit profile, affiliation, role, permission, group, note audience, export, reveal, readiness, lifecycle and support activity with before/after values.

Decision_Register.title: Retention and deletion
Decision_Register.decision: Preserve governed workforce and affiliation history, never delete through deactivation, and remove or anonymize only data legally eligible under platform policy.

Decision_Register.title: Global Person ID
Decision_Register.decision: Create one immutable global Person ID and match using verified account identity, contact, NPN, legal name, DOB and protected SSN token without using SSN as a database key or auto-merging fuzzy matches.

Decision_Register.title: Repeat signup handling
Decision_Register.decision: Use account recovery for an existing verified email; verify and link different-email matches to the existing Person ID; send ambiguous cases to review without disclosing other-tenant relationships.

Decision_Register.title: Credential document ownership
Decision_Register.decision: Store credential files and versions in M13 and credential metadata, validation, expiration and linkage in M08 while embedding upload, view, status and remediation in M06 profiles.

Decision_Register.title: Initial data posture
Decision_Register.decision: Perform no general legacy migration; seed approved M00 users and M05 organizations and use governed CSV imports. The AMS workbook remains reference only and nonbaseline.

Decision_Register.title: Lower-environment data
Decision_Register.decision: Use synthetic or approved masked data including roles, groups, duplicates, transfers, note audiences, Twilio sandbox messages and mock M08/M13 records.

Decision_Register.title: Performance and scale
Decision_Register.decision: Meet p95 reads within 750 ms and writes within 1.5 seconds excluding provider wait; test 50,000 profiles per tenant, 10,000 per agency and 10,000 rows per import.

Decision_Register.title: Controlled rollout
Decision_Register.decision: Activate by feature control for selected tenants and agencies, begin with a controlled pilot, review results and expand only through release approval.

Decision_Register.title: Launch before M08 and M13
Decision_Register.decision: Allow roster, profiles, affiliations, groups and access administration to launch first while credential decisions and document actions remain visibly gated and no sellability claim is made.

Decision_Register.title: Production activation gates
Decision_Register.decision: Require security, privacy, English and Spanish, accessibility, UAT, migrations, monitoring, Twilio controls, runbooks, prior-module regression and approval of the blocking M00 access delta.

Decision_Register.title: Mandatory UAT journeys
Decision_Register.decision: Test onboarding, roster conversion, custom roles, group inheritance, duplicate signup, transfer, suspension, offboarding, all note audiences, import/export, SMS, referral links and integration failures.

Decision_Register.title: Rollback and emergency disable
Decision_Register.decision: Stop new affected activity without deleting records or rewriting history, revoke stale access, preserve completed work, reconcile downstream systems and show a clear state.

Decision_Register.title: M06 completion definition
Decision_Register.decision: Complete the governed packet, prior-module impacts and deltas, machine registries, UX and technical specifications, tests, implementation instructions, validation evidence and updated execution ledger.

Requirement_Register.title: Roster-only people
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall allow a person to exist on the agency roster without an ABox login. Roster-only profiles cannot sign in, receive system assignments, use referral identity or perform regulated actions, and can later be linked to an M00 user.

Requirement_Register.title: Canonical workforce person model
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall use one tenant-scoped WorkforceProfile for every roster person with optional M00 user and M08 producer references. Administrator is a role assignment, not a separate person type.

Requirement_Register.title: One primary active affiliation
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall permit exactly one primary active agency affiliation in Lucie, preserve complete history and effective dates, and retain a future-safe seam for later concurrent affiliations.

Requirement_Register.title: Basic captivity classification
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall store CAPTIVE, INDEPENDENT or UNSPECIFIED with effective dates, source and history. M08 owns carrier-specific restrictions and selling enforcement.

Requirement_Register.title: Profile fields and embedded credential experience
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall m06 owns the composite Agency and Agent Profile experience and operational fields. M08 owns credential records and M13 owns files; both are embedded without duplicate canonical stores.

Requirement_Register.title: Agency operational readiness
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall link an M06 operational profile to the M05 organization and require active organization and relationship, complete operational setup, valid administrator coverage, support contact and no blocking M06 exception.

Requirement_Register.title: Custom roles and scoped authorization
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall retain immutable M00 starter roles and permit versioned custom workforce roles from controlled permissions. Authorization evaluates permission and explicit scope rather than literal role name where possible.

Requirement_Register.title: Profile activation is not sellability
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall allow an active roster profile and affiliation before sellability. M08 must return an allowed contextual authority result before regulated actions.

Requirement_Register.title: Manual and CSV onboarding
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall manual entry and all-or-nothing CSV import create draft profiles, run duplicate checks, establish affiliation and proposed roles, and never send invitations automatically.

Requirement_Register.title: Suspension and offboarding
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall suspension revokes operational access immediately. Effective-dated offboarding ends affiliation, removes applicable access, triggers downstream reevaluation and reassigns open work while preserving history and attribution.

Requirement_Register.title: Single-workspace setup
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall a standard agent setup must be completable through one guided experience without requiring users to navigate module boundaries.

Requirement_Register.title: Agent Profile sections
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall use Overview, Access and Affiliation, Selling Setup, Marketplace, Tasks and Exceptions, and History as Agent Profile sections.

Requirement_Register.title: Agency Profile sections
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall use Overview, Locations and Contacts, Roster, Selling Setup, Marketplace, Tasks and Exceptions, and History as Agency Profile sections.

Requirement_Register.title: Separate status dimensions
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall maintain separate profile, affiliation, account access, credential readiness, marketplace readiness, availability and contextual selling-authority statuses. Generic Active never implies sellability.

Requirement_Register.title: Guided onboarding sequence
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall use a save-and-resume flow for Profile, Agency and Affiliation, Access, Selling Setup, Marketplace, Review and Activate, skipping inapplicable steps.

Requirement_Register.title: Invitation timing
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall permit profile, affiliation and selling-setup work before invitation. Authorized administrators or the agent may complete permitted portions after account activation.

Requirement_Register.title: Contextual selling readiness
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall show Ready, Ready with limitations, Not ready or Review required only as a summary that opens reason-coded product, carrier, state and channel detail supplied by M08.

Requirement_Register.title: Credential provenance and permissions
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall allow role-permitted entry and update while showing whether credential data is API validated, manually verified, document supported or self reported.

Requirement_Register.title: Remediation tasks
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall missing, rejected, expired or soon-to-expire items create contextual M00 tasks identifying the blocker, resolver, owner and next action.

Requirement_Register.title: Behavior before M08
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall include M08 component slots, interfaces and fixtures but never manufacture a positive selling decision while M08 is unavailable.

Requirement_Register.title: Tenant-scoped workforce identity
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall use an immutable tenant-scoped roster profile that may reference one global M00 user and one M08 producer identity without exposing another tenant's data.

Requirement_Register.title: Profile and affiliation states
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall use DRAFT, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED and INACTIVE for profiles and PLANNED, ACTIVE, ENDED and CANCELED for affiliations; readiness remains separate.

Requirement_Register.title: Effective dates and corrections
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall support immediate and future effective timestamps, prohibit overlapping primary affiliations, and use governed correction records once downstream activity exists.

Requirement_Register.title: Transfer release and rehire
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall permit atomic same-hierarchy transfer by authorized root or JET users, downline release within scope, cross-tenant migration controls, and rehire through the existing profile.

Requirement_Register.title: Office and manager assignments
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall office and manager are optional operational assignments, must be valid and acyclic, may drive routing and reporting, and grant no authority by themselves.

Requirement_Register.title: Visibility and self service
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall apply M05 root/downline scope, limit ordinary users to their own composite profile, and allow self update only for approved operational fields.

Requirement_Register.title: Roster list search and filters
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall provide fixed columns, search and filters for profile, affiliation, access, readiness, groups, tasks and marketplace status; exclude custom columns and saved views.

Requirement_Register.title: Duplicate detection link and merge
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall check verified email, linked user, roster reference and producer identity; never auto-merge fuzzy matches; preserve aliases, history, tasks and downstream references in governed merges.

Requirement_Register.title: Roster import and export authority
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall use M00 job orchestration with M06 templates, validations and scope. Imports are atomic; exports are purpose-bound, masked, audited and time limited.

Requirement_Register.title: Safe bulk actions
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall allow only office, manager, invitation, task and approved export actions after preflight. Exclude role, lifecycle, transfer, credential, referral and selling-authority bulk changes.

Requirement_Register.title: Four note audiences
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall support ME_ONLY, AGENCY_VISIBLE, JET_ONLY and CUSTOMER_VISIBLE with exact audience scope, confirmation, withdrawal, retention and audited break-glass behavior.

Requirement_Register.title: Access ownership split
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall m00 owns permission catalogue, role engine, versioning, assignments and effective access. M06 owns business units, teams, memberships and agency-facing assignment workflows.

Requirement_Register.title: Custom role constraints
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall allow agencies to bundle only controlled agency-assignable permissions and prohibit custom permissions, JET authority, cross-tenant grants and system-policy overrides.

Requirement_Register.title: Custom role lifecycle
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall use DRAFT, ACTIVE and RETIRED; editing an active role creates a new draft version; roles cannot contain or inherit other roles.

Requirement_Register.title: Business unit and team hierarchy
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall support one optional business-unit level and one optional team level inside one M05 organization, with no nesting or cross-agency groups.

Requirement_Register.title: Scoped role assignments
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall assign roles directly or through group membership with explicit organization, business unit, team, self, assigned-record or owned-record scope.

Requirement_Register.title: No implicit authority
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall manager, team lead, job title, profile category and office assignments create no access without an explicit role assignment.

Requirement_Register.title: Resource authorization context
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall resources using group scope must carry or reliably derive organization, optional business unit, optional team and assigned user context; ambiguity fails closed.

Requirement_Register.title: Access administration safeguards
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall allow agency administrators to manage custom roles within scope while preventing JET authority and self-elevation; require recent authentication, reason and impact preview for sensitive changes.

Requirement_Register.title: Immediate access invalidation
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall role, permission, group and membership changes invalidate stale effective access immediately; active sessions and jobs reauthorize.

Requirement_Register.title: Roles and Access front end
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall provide System Roles, Custom Role Builder, Business Units and Teams, Role Assignments, Effective Access Inspector, Version History and Access Audit; exclude a free-form policy language.

Requirement_Register.title: Progressive adoption
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall preserve existing starter-role assignments and allow agencies to introduce custom roles progressively without redesigning all access at launch.

Requirement_Register.title: Agency Administration Home
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall provide one fixed agency-context home with roster, readiness, access, groups, tasks, exceptions, marketplace and credential summaries and explicit root/downline context.

Requirement_Register.title: Agent Workspace
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall provide one unified workspace for profile, affiliation, roles, groups, availability, credential and marketplace status, tasks and owner-managed downstream links.

Requirement_Register.title: Readiness contract
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall use READY, READY_WITH_LIMITATIONS, NOT_READY, REVIEW_REQUIRED and NOT_APPLICABLE with reason codes, owner, evaluation time, source version and next action.

Requirement_Register.title: Agency operational-readiness contract
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall publish authoritative M06 agency operational readiness based on M05 lifecycle, administrator coverage, support contact, defaults and blocking exceptions; marketplace activation remains M04-owned.

Requirement_Register.title: Operational agent eligibility
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall return OPERATIONALLY_ELIGIBLE, OPERATIONALLY_INELIGIBLE or REVIEW_REQUIRED based on profile, affiliation, scope, permission, availability and M06 blockers, never final regulatory authority.

Requirement_Register.title: Embedded referral-link experience
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall embed M04 referral-link components in profiles, roster and onboarding; M04 owns token and lifecycle, and raw tokens never enter M06 logs, exports or search.

Requirement_Register.title: Operational availability
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall support AVAILABLE, NOT_ACCEPTING_NEW_WORK and TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE with dates, reason and history; affect new work only and create review tasks for existing work.

Requirement_Register.title: Affiliation operational attributes
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall own affiliation status, dates, category, captivity, office, manager, business unit, teams, roles, languages, availability, onboarding and offboarding context, source and history.

Requirement_Register.title: Operational service scope
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall allow optional US-state and customer-service-language scope at agency, business unit, team and agent levels; lower levels may narrow but not expand agency scope and do not prove sellability.

Requirement_Register.title: Defaults and explicit propagation
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall copy fixed defaults at creation or explicitly apply later with impact preview; never silently propagate. Root role templates copy to local versioned roles without live inheritance.

Requirement_Register.title: Tasks and exceptions
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall use tasks for assigned work and exceptions for controlled blocking or review conditions. Closing tasks never closes an exception until system revalidation confirms resolution.

Requirement_Register.title: Notification triggers
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall notify only for action or awareness, including onboarding blockers, invitations, access changes, transfers, suspensions, offboarding, readiness changes and unresolved exceptions.

Requirement_Register.title: SMS through Twilio
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall support in-product, email and SMS through Twilio using verified mobile numbers, consent and preferences, minimal content, retries and delivery status.

Requirement_Register.title: Notification ownership
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall m06 defines trigger, audience, urgency and action; shared notification services own templates and delivery; critical work remains an M00 task.

Requirement_Register.title: Fixed escalation
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall use fixed severity-based escalation to assignee then responsible team or administrator; agencies select responsible users or teams but cannot create unrestricted rules.

Requirement_Register.title: Deduplication and digest
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall deduplicate repeated events, link to the affected record, use immediate notices for blocking or access events and group routine reminders into a daily digest.

Requirement_Register.title: Fixed operational reports
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall provide fixed reports for roster, onboarding, invitations, roles, groups, lifecycle, tasks, exceptions, marketplace readiness and referral status.

Requirement_Register.title: No custom report builder
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall exclude a custom report builder in Lucie; provide useful fixed filters and sorting.

Requirement_Register.title: CSV exports
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall use on-demand CSV export through M00 job orchestration and exclude scheduled report delivery in Lucie.

Requirement_Register.title: Report access controls
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall apply effective role and organization scope, mask sensitive fields, require export purpose, audit every export and use time-limited reauthorized downloads.

Requirement_Register.title: Credential report boundary
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall include M08 readiness summaries, blocker counts and expiration indicators; detailed license and appointment reporting remains M08-owned.

Requirement_Register.title: Versioned APIs
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall provide versioned APIs for profiles, affiliations, groups, availability, lifecycle and operational controls; public third-party APIs are excluded.

Requirement_Register.title: Composite read APIs
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall provide composite Agency and Agent Profile reads that label owner and refresh time and do not create duplicate editable copies.

Requirement_Register.title: Published events
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall publish profile, affiliation, group, availability, readiness, lifecycle and offboarding events with sensitive-data minimization.

Requirement_Register.title: Idempotency and concurrency
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall use idempotency keys, entity versions, correlation IDs and consumer deduplication, and reject stale updates.

Requirement_Register.title: Critical synchronous controls
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall complete access revocation, tenant validation, affiliation validation and suspension controls before showing success; safe downstream updates may process asynchronously.

Requirement_Register.title: Integration failure behavior
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall allow safe draft work, fail closed for access, activation, marketplace eligibility and selling authority, retry automatically and create visible exceptions and tasks.

Requirement_Register.title: Canonical reconciliation
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall run scheduled and on-demand reconciliation; canonical owner wins, differences are logged and material conflicts create exceptions without silent overwrite.

Requirement_Register.title: DOB and SSN handling
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall store DOB in a protected global person identity record when required and full SSN only in an encrypted tokenized sensitive-data vault; M06 shows verification status or permitted masked values.

Requirement_Register.title: Sensitive-field display
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall mask sensitive values by default, require permission, scope, reason and audit to reveal, and exclude them from logs, events, notifications and standard exports.

Requirement_Register.title: Recent authentication
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall require recent authentication for privilege elevation, sensitive exports, cross-agency transfer, suspension, offboarding, break-glass and administrator-coverage changes.

Requirement_Register.title: JET support access
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall require explicit tenant and agency context, support-mode banner, purpose capture, time-limited access and complete audit; prohibit unrestricted browsing.

Requirement_Register.title: Separate approval
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall require independent approval for self-elevation and removal of the last active administrator; routine permitted assignments do not require dual approval.

Requirement_Register.title: Immutable audit
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall audit profile, affiliation, role, permission, group, note audience, export, reveal, readiness, lifecycle and support activity with before/after values.

Requirement_Register.title: Retention and deletion
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall preserve governed workforce and affiliation history, never delete through deactivation, and remove or anonymize only data legally eligible under platform policy.

Requirement_Register.title: Global Person ID
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall create one immutable global Person ID and match using verified account identity, contact, NPN, legal name, DOB and protected SSN token without using SSN as a database key or auto-merging fuzzy matches.

Requirement_Register.title: Repeat signup handling
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall use account recovery for an existing verified email; verify and link different-email matches to the existing Person ID; send ambiguous cases to review without disclosing other-tenant relationships.

Requirement_Register.title: Credential document ownership
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall store credential files and versions in M13 and credential metadata, validation, expiration and linkage in M08 while embedding upload, view, status and remediation in M06 profiles.

Requirement_Register.title: Initial data posture
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall perform no general legacy migration; seed approved M00 users and M05 organizations and use governed CSV imports. The AMS workbook remains reference only and nonbaseline.

Requirement_Register.title: Lower-environment data
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall use synthetic or approved masked data including roles, groups, duplicates, transfers, note audiences, Twilio sandbox messages and mock M08/M13 records.

Requirement_Register.title: Performance and scale
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall meet p95 reads within 750 ms and writes within 1.5 seconds excluding provider wait; test 50,000 profiles per tenant, 10,000 per agency and 10,000 rows per import.

Requirement_Register.title: Controlled rollout
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall activate by feature control for selected tenants and agencies, begin with a controlled pilot, review results and expand only through release approval.

Requirement_Register.title: Launch before M08 and M13
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall allow roster, profiles, affiliations, groups and access administration to launch first while credential decisions and document actions remain visibly gated and no sellability claim is made.

Requirement_Register.title: Production activation gates
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall require security, privacy, English and Spanish, accessibility, UAT, migrations, monitoring, Twilio controls, runbooks, prior-module regression and approval of the blocking M00 access delta.

Requirement_Register.title: Mandatory UAT journeys
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall test onboarding, roster conversion, custom roles, group inheritance, duplicate signup, transfer, suspension, offboarding, all note audiences, import/export, SMS, referral links and integration failures.

Requirement_Register.title: Rollback and emergency disable
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall stop new affected activity without deleting records or rewriting history, revoke stale access, preserve completed work, reconcile downstream systems and show a clear state.

Requirement_Register.title: M06 completion definition
Requirement_Register.statement: The platform shall complete the governed packet, prior-module impacts and deltas, machine registries, UX and technical specifications, tests, implementation instructions, validation evidence and updated execution ledger.
